home.title: Follow the evidence from gene to insight.
home.description: GeneLab is a bilingual foundation for exploring molecular genetics, connecting traceable scientific sources with transparent computational analysis.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search genes, variants, proteins, or literature
home.workflowDescription: Move from a biological entity to its evidence, then make the computational step explicit.
home.noticeTitle: Built for learning and research support
home.notice: GeneLab is not a diagnostic system, a substitute for genetic counseling, laboratory validation, or peer-reviewed scientific judgment.

sourceLimit.localFiles: File rows and summaries come from user-provided local files. Derived metrics are computed in the browser and are not database assertions.

population.title: Population frequencies and dbSNP
population.cohortNote: Database-reported frequency depends on the sampled cohort. Values are shown separately by population and source; no global frequency or clinical classification is calculated.
population.frequencyPrecisionNote: Frequencies are shown with source-level precision. Source rounding or denominators may mean allele values do not sum to exactly 100%.
population.rsIdInput: rsID from the ClinVar record or entered by you
population.userIdentifierNote: The rsID is used as an identifier only. No coordinates are inferred from sequence input.
population.mergedRsIds: Merged or superseded rsIDs reported by dbSNP
population.noMergedRsIds: No merged or superseded rsIDs were reported.
population.invalidRsId: Enter an rsID such as rs123.

population.ensemblError: Ensembl population frequencies could not be retrieved.

sample.title: Physical sample registry
sample.help: Manage coded sample records locally and keep an append-only history of edits and linked analyses.
sample.privacyNotice: Do not enter personal identifiers of human donors. Use coded IDs only. Samples and files stay in this browser and may be lost if browser storage is cleared unless exported.
sample.humanDerivedReminder: Human-derived material: enter coded sample IDs only. Do not store donor names, contact details, dates of birth, or other direct identifiers.

sample.error.corruptRegistry: The stored sample registry is invalid or uses an unsupported schema version.

sample.error.duplicateId: This sample ID has already been issued and cannot be reused.

sample.error.notFound: The requested sample was not found.
sample.error.invalidImport: The registry file is invalid or could not be parsed.
sample.error.importTooLarge: Registry imports are limited to 2 MiB.
privacy.title: Privacy and data handling
privacy.fileNotice: Selected files are read and processed locally in this browser and are never uploaded. Browser storage can be cleared by the user or browser; export records you need to keep.

fileImport.error.gzip-unsupported: This browser does not support gzip decompression. Choose an uncompressed file.
fileImport.error.invalid-utf8: The file is not valid UTF-8 text.
fileImport.error.fastq-invalid-separator: FASTQ separator line must start with +.

fileImport.error.vcf-result-expired: The VCF result is no longer in this worker. Reimport the file to continue.

fileImport.notebookSaved: Result saved to the local notebook.
fileImport.supportedFormatsText: FASTQ and VCF are streamed in the local Web Worker up to 200 MB by default; CSV/TSV is limited to 10 MB. gzip is supported when this browser provides DecompressionStream. FASTQ/VCF results remain user-file data and locally computed summaries, not database assertions.

lab.noRestrictionSites: No supported restriction sites were found.

geneId.title: Gene identification and variant detection
geneId.help: No sequence is uploaded. A gene/accession label may be sent to NCBI/Ensembl for metadata lookup. A VCF rsID is sent to ClinVar only when you request that lookup. Sequence data is never submitted. A header/file label is not proof of gene identity.
geneId.noSequence: No sequence records were available for identification.
geneId.identityTooltip: Exact matching aligned nucleotide columns divided by total alignment columns.
geneId.coverageTooltip: Query residues aligned opposite a reference residue, excluding insertion columns; this is not genomic coverage.
geneId.alignmentTruncated: Preview truncated; exported JSON contains the full aligned sequences.
geneId.noVariants: This module did not call reference differences. A compatible reference is required; low-confidence alignments are not called.
geneId.variantLimit: Showing the first 100 variants; {count} more are available in the JSON and CSV exports.
geneId.annotationHelp: A sequence alone does not identify a gene without a reference search. Add a gene symbol or accession to the FASTA header for metadata lookup.
geneId.annotationNotFound: NCBI Gene did not resolve this explicit input label; sequence-based identity remains unconfirmed.
geneId.annotationSource: Metadata was resolved from a gene/accession label in the input using NCBI Gene. It is not sequence-based gene identification.
geneId.proteinUnavailable: Protein impact requires a complete, verified coding sequence and coding position.
geneId.normalizationUnavailable: Normalization unavailable: reference mismatch or insufficient context.
geneId.notClinicalPrediction: Computational consequence only; not clinical interpretation.
geneId.sampleMatrixNote: Presence/absence across confidently aligned FASTA records only; this is not genotype or allele frequency.
geneId.sampleAbsent: Variant not detected in this record
geneId.referenceMapNote: Reference-relative positions only; no exon structure or genomic coordinates are inferred.
geneId.lookupClinvar: Look up this rsID in ClinVar
geneId.inputVcfCaution: These values are displayed as supplied in the VCF INFO field. They are not independently verified and are not a clinical diagnosis.
geneId.vcfCoordinateNote: Position and chromosome are copied from the VCF; reference assembly and normalization were not verified.
geneId.consequenceUnavailable: Could not be determined from sequence data alone.
geneId.referenceRelative: Position is relative to the supplied reference (base or insertion boundary), not a genomic coordinate.

assistant.title: Evidence research assistant
assistant.help: Retrieve a gene record and organize verified fields for orientation. This tool does not generate clinical interpretations or unsupported scientific claims.
assistant.limitText: This view organizes retrieved database fields. It is not an AI authority, diagnosis, or substitute for scientific judgment.
about.title: About and methodology
about.mission: GeneLab connects human gene records, variants, proteins, computation, and scientific sources in a transparent educational workspace.
about.methodText: Records are retrieved through public scientific APIs, normalized into typed models, and displayed with source identifiers and retrieval dates. Missing fields remain unavailable rather than being inferred.
about.safetyText: GeneLab is for education and research support. It is not a diagnostic system, clinical interpretation service, genetic counseling service, or laboratory replacement.
sources.title: Scientific sources
sources.help: Official databases connected or prepared for GeneLab. Each source has a distinct scope and evidence role.
